Variant/control declarations require unique names and distinguish red assertions from green controls; encapsulation 5/10, invariant expression 8/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Regular-file leases validate opened descriptors, associate bytes with permission modes and scope handle lifetime; encapsulation 8/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 8/10.

Snapshot records pair content with modes, explicitly represent unreadable inputs and bind parsed manifest bytes to fingerprints; encapsulation 6/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 10/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Group-cleanup results distinguish verified absence of live members from remaining members or observation failures; encapsulation 7/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 8/10.

Step-result dictionaries retain diagnostics and reject timeout, truncation, capture, reaping and group-cleanup failures as successful evidence; encapsulation 6/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 10/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Result rows and reports require ordered declaration coverage, restoration, independently checked phase evidence and current fingerprints before publication; encapsulation 5/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 10/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Output reservations scope checked handles, reject filesystem identity aliases and track newly created destinations for refusal cleanup; encapsulation 8/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.
